title: Can David Beat Goliath? On Multi-Hop Reasoning with Resource-Constrained Agents
abstract: arXiv:2601.21699v3 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-turn reasoning agents solve complex questions by decomposing them into intermediate retrieval or tool-use steps, for accumulating supporting evidence across turns. Meanwhile, with reinforcement learning (RL), training these agents rely on many on-policy rollouts and large training batches. Under realistic resource constraints that make dense exploration infeasible, each RL batch contains only few useful reasoning paths from the current policy. Existing approaches do not fully address this bottleneck: SFT-based initialization can overfit when annotated trajectories are scarce, retrieval-level rewards can assign credit to individual retrieved documents without directly optimizing coverage of the full evidence set, and expansion can waste rollouts from poorly chosen prefixes. translated_title: 大卫能打败歌利亚吗？资源受限智能体的多跳推理研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.21699v3 公告类型：交叉 摘要：多轮推理智能体通过将复杂问题分解为中间检索或工具使用步骤来解决问题，从而在多个回合中积累支持性证据。同时，使用强化学习（RL）训练这些智能体依赖于许多在线策略回放和大型训练批次。在现实资源约束下，密集探索不可行，每个RL批次仅包含当前策略中的少量有用推理路径。现有方法未能完全解决这一瓶颈：基于SFT的初始化在标注轨迹稀缺时可能过拟合，检索级奖励可以分配信用给单个检索文档，但未直接优化整个证据集的覆盖范围，扩展可能浪费来自选择不当前缀的回放。我们引入了David-GRPO，通过利用当前策略外部和内部的信息来改进小批量学习：（i）专家引导注入
tldr: 本文提出David-GRPO方法，通过结合外部专家知识和内部策略信息，有效解决了资源受限条件下多跳推理强化学习中小批量训练效率低下的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces David-GRPO, which improves small-batch training efficiency for multi-hop reasoning under resource constraints by integrating external expert knowledge and internal policy information.
